answer: The premise is reversed and the attribution is off. BlogCatalog is a social network (blogger friendship links), and PPI (protein-protein interaction) is the biological network. LINE (Tang et al., 2015) does not use either dataset; its experiments use Language, Flickr, YouTube, Twitter, and DBLP. The comparison you describe comes from node2vec (Grover & Leskovec, 2016), which uses both BlogCatalog and PPI. Node2vec reports that BlogCatalog behaves more homophilous (community-based, so BFS-like and DFS-style exploration captures communities), while PPI reflects structural equivalence (nodes with similar hub or bridge roles, which the method captures with BFS-biased walks). So the contrast is between homophily in the social network and structural equivalence in the biological network.
